d: India is planning to build an 11,200 MW hydropower project in Geku village in Arunachal Pradesh’s Upper Siang district. The Siang Upper Multipurpose Project has been in the works for years, but China’s plans for the world’s largest hydropower dam upstream have given it renewed urgency, with the government increasingly framing it as a national security imperative. However, local communities are protesting the proposed project, while the region’s fragile Himalayan ecosystem raises serious environmental and geological concerns.
